observation: Heading hierarchy: the original has no h1. Its outline starts at h3 'Sign up' and h4 'Cart', jumps between h2–h5, and includes empty headings. The AI-built page has one h1 ('Performance suspension, built to drive.'), with 8 h2 section titles and 29 h3 card titles beneath it.

Semantic landmarks: the original is div-heavy (462 divs) with 1 header, 1 main, 2 sections, 1 footer and no nav or article. The AI-built page has 88 divs, 1 header, 1 nav, 1 main, 8 sections, 2 articles and 1 footer.

Code footprint: the original looks like a WordPress/Flatsome theme, with 32 scripts, 29 style tags, 45 noscript tags, 5 stylesheets, 97 inline style attributes and 504 unique custom classes. The AI-built page uses a single inline style element with no stylesheets, 1 script, 8 inline style attributes and 44 unique semantic class names. Both have a low Tailwind-like fraction (0.042 vs 0.019).
Layout technique: the original uses flexbox only (128 flex, 0 grid). The AI-built page combines flex (59) and CSS grid (9).
A white cookie-consent banner with a shadow, a green 'Cookie settings' link and a black 'ACCEPT' button is pinned across the top of the viewport and covers the header.
A thin black utility bar above the header shows shipping text on the left and phone (in bold), hours and email on the right, in small white text.
Both headers place a red-and-black Ridetech logo image at the left.

Header controls: the original has a search field with a magnifier button and a pill-shaped cart showing $0.00. The AI-built page has a search form with a square black 'Go' button and plain 'Cart' and 'Login' text links.

Primary navigation: the original has a full-width dark slate (rgb 58,72,86) menu bar with ten uppercase, letter-spaced items and chevron dropdowns. The AI-built page has a six-link text nav inside the header that wraps, pushing 'Contact' onto a second row.

Hero: the original has a full-width image slider (1440x338) whose headline and logo are baked into the raster image (red 'NEW TOUCH SCREEN CONTROL PANEL', RidePro e5). The AI-built page has a 609px-tall full-bleed photo under a dark overlay, with live left-aligned text: a 60.8px/700 white h1, a paragraph and buttons.
The hero has a small, letter-spaced, uppercase salmon-red eyebrow reading 'JASPER, INDIANA'.
The hero has two square-cornered 56px CTAs: a solid red primary button and a transparent secondary button with a white outline.

The promotional banners (Silverado, RidePRO-E5, Falcon) are full-width hero slider slides in the original. In the AI-built page they are cropped to 270x169 as the images of a four-column 'Featured' row of cards, which cuts off their baked-in text.
The slider uses lazy-load placeholders: zero-size inline SVG data URIs and a 1x1 GIF.
Below the hero, a full-width solid red band carries the free-shipping message in centred, bold white text.

Palette: both are neutral with a single saturated red accent (original rgb 220,31,38; AI-built rgb 215,25,32). The original adds slate blue-grey (58,72,86) surfaces, cool light-grey panels (243,245,247) and grey text. The AI-built page uses near-black text (20,20,20), white, warm grey (244,244,242) and black bands.

Body text: both use 16px with a 25.6px line height. The original sets it in Open Sans in mid-grey #777, with Lucida Grande on 163 elements and the fl-icons icon font. The AI-built page sets it in a system-ui sans stack in near-black rgb(20,20,20) and uses no web fonts.

Section headings: the original's h2s are 25.6px/700 Open Sans, centred over the shop columns and left-aligned in the sidebar. The AI-built page's h2s are 33.6px/700 system sans, each with a short red underline bar and a red right-aligned arrow link opposite.
Tile labels: the original uses small, bold, uppercase, letter-spaced grey text, centred and wrapping to 2–4 lines. The AI-built cards use bold sentence/title-case labels.
'Shop by Vehicle' shows five equal columns, each with a red car-silhouette PNG (muscle-car.png, truck.png and others) above its label.
Shop by Vehicle presentation: in the original the silhouettes sit unframed on white. The AI-built page puts them in 214x235 cards on a light-grey band and adds a 'Load Leveling' pill link below.
A thick, empty near-black band about 60px tall separates the vehicle row from the product section.

Shop by Product grid: the original is a four-column grid of 18 square 188x188 tiles whose last row holds two items. The AI-built page is a five-column grid of 11 cards whose last row holds a single orphan ('Universal 4-Links').

Product photos are catalogue cutouts on white in both. The original shows them unframed with no card styling. The AI-built page wraps them in thin-bordered cards with light rounded corners, each card a single anchor.
A 'MORE CATEGORIES' label in small uppercase grey text introduces a wrapping cluster of rounded pill links (LevelTow Kits, Tru Turn and others).

Overall layout: the original has two columns, a main column about 930px wide plus a sidebar about 450px wide. The AI-built page is a single column inside a centred container about 1148px wide (x 146–1294) with full-bleed section backgrounds.

Catalog and warranty promos: the original stacks raster banners in the sidebar (FREE Shipping graphic, 1,000,001 MILE WARRANTY banner, FREE Product Catalog tile with a shadowed white card and a red pill 'REQUEST A CATALOG' button). The AI-built page uses a two-column catalog band with a shadowed cover image, a live h2, a paragraph, a red CTA and a text link, and mentions the warranty as a text link.

Sign-up form: the original's form sits in the sidebar in a bordered white box, with First Name, Last Name and Email fields, bold labels, thin-bordered square inputs and a red 'SIGN UP' button. The AI-built page uses a black split band with a white h2 on the left and, on the right, dark-grey inputs (first and last name sharing a row) with bold labels above them, a full-width red submit button and an empty status paragraph.

Latest News: the original has two sidebar entries, each with a 450x253 photo, a bold centred caption, a divider and a '[…]' excerpt, closed by a red 'VIEW ALL NEWS' button. The AI-built page has two image-less article cards with a thick red left border and a red 'Read more →' link, followed by a row of pill links.
News photos are cropped from 500x375 and 500x333 to the same 450x253 box and have empty alt text.

Buttons: the original's primary 'GET A FREE CATALOG' button is red with a 99px pill radius, and the other buttons are red rectangles with uppercase text. The AI-built page's measured primary button is the black square 'Go' (radius 0, padding 8px 12px), and its red CTAs are also square-cornered.

Corner radii: both are mostly square. The original has 1186 elements at 0 and 17 at pill radius, with very little mid-range rounding. The AI-built page has 264 at 0, 21 at 8–15px, 17 at 16px or more and none at pill radius.
Neither page uses gradient backgrounds, backdrop blur or keyframe animations.

Depth and motion: the original has 16 box shadows, 372 elements with transitions and 21 with transforms. The AI-built page has 1 box shadow (on the catalog cover), 20 transitions and 0 transforms, and gets depth mainly from 1px borders and background shifts.
A black strip with a downward-pointing triangle notch at its centre introduces the about section.

Both pages use the darkened orange muscle-car-on-track photo behind white text. In the original it is the background of a mid-page about section ('ridetech.com' h2, a subheading and a paragraph of about 70 words). In the AI-built page it is the hero background behind the h1.
A red call-to-action strip reads 'Don't see what you're looking for? Let us know!' in bold white, with 'Connect With Us:' at the right.
Social links: the original shows five circular white-outline icon-font icons. The AI-built page shows small bordered rectangular text buttons in its contact section.

Four-column link lists with thin divider lines: in the original these form the footer (Contact Info, Information, Applications, Your Account) on a dark grey fill. In the AI-built page they form a 'Technical Resources' section (TECH, SUPPORT, COMMUNITY, YOUR ACCOUNT), and the near-black footer is reduced to a logo, policy links and copyright.

Link-column headings: the original mixes bold title-case ('Contact Info', 'Your Account') with uppercase letter-spaced headings ('INFORMATION', 'APPLICATIONS'). The AI-built page uses uppercase letter-spaced h3s for every column.

Contact details: the original lists them in a footer column with bold run-in labels ('Phone:', 'Fax:', 'Hours:') and plain-text address and email. The AI-built page gives them a three-column section (Visit, Call or write, Hours) with h3s, a semantic address element and red underlined phone and email links.

The free-catalog offer appears several times on each page: in the original in the primary button, the sidebar tile and a footer 'FREE CATALOG' image; in the AI-built page in the hero button, the catalog section CTA and an arrow link.
Both pages include the copyright line 'Copyright 2021 © Ridetech'.
The bottom bar shows muted payment-card icons (Visa, Mastercard, Discover, American Express, PayPal) next to the copyright on a lighter grey fill.
The footer shows the logo on a white rounded tile and four small grey policy links aligned right, above a hairline rule.
Both pages use product-led commercial copy that repeats the free shipping on orders over $100 offer (the original in its hero band and sidebar; the AI-built page in its utility bar and red banner).

Copy length and punctuation: the original has 486 words, 3 exclamation marks, 0 em dashes and 1 emoji. The AI-built page has 450 words, 1 exclamation mark, 2 em dashes and no emoji, with short label-style headings and a slogan h1.
Promotional messaging: in the original most of it is baked into raster JPG/PNG banners. In the AI-built page it is live HTML text (h1, banner text, catalog section).
Images: the original has 43 img elements, 2 missing alt and 10 SVGs. The AI-built page has 24 img elements, none missing alt, no SVGs, and an empty alt on the decorative hero.

Metadata: the original has a JSON-LD block, Open Graph and Twitter tags, a robots tag, the title 'Ridetech Home - Ridetech' and lang en-US. The AI-built page has only charset, viewport and description meta tags, no JSON-LD, the title 'Ridetech | Performance Suspension Systems' and lang en.

Page length: the original is 1440x4129, with an empty area beside the taller sidebar after the product grid ends. The AI-built page is 1440x5191, a sequential stack of 8 sections with about 64px of vertical padding each.
The DOM contains hidden or off-canvas content that is not visible on screen: 5 tables with 96 td (likely a mini-cart), 4 forms and 7 buttons.
Section backgrounds alternate in a regular rhythm between white and light grey (rgb 244,244,242), with black for the signup band and footer.
Links follow a consistent system: bold dark nav links, bold red section links ending in '→', and underlined red inline contact links.
An off-screen 'Skip to content' link is the first element in the DOM. Overall ARIA use is light (3 attributes, compared with 60 on the original).
